<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 262.0994) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈262.0994 – 1.0073 = 261.0921 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1, consistent with ~14 carbons) is C₁₄H₁₃O₅ (exact mass = 261.0763 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are indicated, so the molecular formula is C14H13O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H13O5</final_answer>
